remainingLimitations: Counts are an illustrative maximum when every attempt fails with a retryable error (2 runtime attempts x 3 library attempts: first try plus two retries); real calls often succeed early, and lower layers such as gRPC may retry transparently or by error class.
Each control compares policies for the same failing call; switching a valve does not undo requests already sent.
The scene shows attempt multiplication and trace visibility, not the shared deadline or backoff timing; those remain in the guide and video.
Pipes and valves are a metaphor, not a model of network behaviour.
Rapid alternating toggles and keyboard-only navigation were exercised only through button clicks in headless Chrome; coordinator should confirm in the integrated host.
recommendationRationale: Reader-selected retry ownership with a visible service count beside the runtime trace is a spatial counterfactual the recommended video cannot offer; the revision removes the occluding cabinet and the semantic errors. Requires renewed independent critique before promotion.
